facts.text: Metro trains in Copenhagen were originally planned to be four cars long, but were cut to three cars per set as a savings measure.
Platforms at Vanløse station are built to accommodate four‑car trains, with automatic doors that can be modified if longer trains are needed.
The M3 line is a fully underground circular route that links Copenhagen Central Station with Vesterbro, Frederiksberg, Nørrebro, Østerbro and Indre By.
Forum Station earned a nomination for the European Union Prize for Contemporary Architecture in 2005.
Metro construction began in November 1996, starting with the relocation of underground pipes and wires around station areas.
Preparations for the metro started in 2010, with construction sites and stations opening in 2011.
